newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Xpress sees Q2 net above projections.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Xpress sees Q2 net above projections.

text.p: U.S. Xpress Enterprises Inc said Wednesday it expects earnings in the second quarter, ending September 30, will exceed current analysts' expectations of $0.10 to $0.12 per share.
"Increased demand, improved utilization and cost reductions are combining to significantly improve financial performance this quarter," said Max L. Fuller, co-chairman.
"This improved performance is being achieved despite higher fuel costs. We thus expect that earnings for the current quarter will exceed the current analyst forecasts of $0.10 to $0.12 per share."
The company noted earnings for the comparable quarter last year were $0.03 per share.
